title: Minimum on-site car parking spaces, Perth and Peel (Table 2.3a)
text: Applies to development within the Perth and Peel regions only. Occupant parking. C2.3.1 Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a.

replaces.note: R25 and below: Location A 1 bed 1 -> 0, 2 bed 1 -> 0 (3+ bed stays 1); Location B 2+ bed 2 -> 1; aged/accessible/small dwelling rows absorbed into bedroom rows

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Occupant parking, Perth and Peel (heading p18). Table 2.3a p19 minimums are the same as Chapter 2. Per dwelling: parking.spaces and proposal.bedrooms describe the dwelling tested (for mixed developments assess each dwelling type). Minimum covers all parking types on site. Ancillary row and R50+ maximum column are C2.3.1-r1 to -r3; visitor parking is C2.3.3.
